sentences.text: Last summer, I visited Japan for the first time.
sentences.translation: 去年夏天我第一次去了日本。

sentences.text: I was amazed by the beautiful temples and gardens.
sentences.translation: 我被美丽的寺庙和花园震撼到了。

sentences.text: The food was incredible, especially the sushi in Tokyo.
sentences.translation: 食物非常棒，尤其是东京的寿司。

sentences.text: I also learned a few basic phrases in Japanese.
sentences.translation: 我还学了一些基础的日语短语。

sentences.text: The locals were very friendly and helpful.
sentences.translation: 当地人非常友好和乐于助人。

sentences.text: I can't wait to go back and explore more of the country.
sentences.translation: 我等不及要再去探索这个国家更多地方。
